Class MapViewport

java.lang.Object
dev.tamboui.widgets.map.MapViewport
public final class MapViewport extends Object
Immutable equirectangular bounds in degrees. East may exceed 180 to cross the antimeridian (for example 170 to 190). Longitude increases rightwards.

      public MapViewport(double west, double east, double south, double north)
      Creates bounds with a longitude span of at most 360 degrees.
      Parameters:
      west - western longitude in [-180, 180)
      east - eastern longitude, greater than west and at most west + 360
      south - southern latitude in [-90, 90)
      north - northern latitude, greater than south and at most 90
